# External ecosystem reviews

This directory contains outside perspectives on PegaConstellation and Infinite Optical Fabric. These documents are published for transparency and discussion; they are not independent audits, peer review, or verification of the technical and numerical claims they describe.

Readers should distinguish between an external reviewer’s characterization of the project and the repository-grounded evidence in the [IOF editorial and evidence review](../IOF_Editorial_and_Evidence_Review.md). In particular, design targets, conceptual metrics, and architectural analogies should not be read as measured hardware results or production deployments without methods, units, raw data, and reproducible runs.

The files are preserved with their original attribution and wording wherever possible.
